cohort: 77 women who experienced PUR out of 23,844 deliveries (vaginal and cesarean section) at an academic institution between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2019
finding: Protracted PUR (lasting ≥3 days postpartum) occurred in 0.05% of deliveries and was associated with a significantly later diagnosis, longer time to onset, and longer duration compared to PUR resolving before postpartum day 3.
